item.title: Asymmetric Arsenals: Dual-Use AI Breaches and Silicon Evasion Strain Western Edge
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
From AI-powered breaches of US spy agencies to illicit $270M GPU flows in China, Western defense modernizers face dual threats of digital exploitation and structural friction. Alexander Sterling breaks down the strategic fallout.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Illicit financing networks totaling hundreds of millions continue bypassing semiconductor export limits, fueling Chinese AI server infrastructure. [SPLIT] ⚡ Automated data collection and bot-driven public records clearing overload civilian-military bureaucracies, creating systemic operational friction. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/asymmetric-arsenals-dual-use-ai-breaches-and-silicon-evasion-strain-western-edge-615103.html

item.title: Algorithmic DoS: How AI Data Harvesters Are Paralysing Open Government
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Venture-backed startups and automated LLM tools are flooding public records systems with tens of thousands of automated FOIA requests daily. Is America's open-government infrastructure facing a structural Denial-of-Service attack?
[SPLIT] ⚡ Commercial entities account for up to 96% of public records inquiries at key federal agencies, transforming open-government mandates into proprietary corporate intelligence pipelines. [SPLIT] ⚡ Local administrative nodes face severe operational gridlock, diverting critical public-sector labor away from core governance functions toward manual data processing. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/algorithmic-dos-how-ai-data-harvesters-are-paralysing-open-government-615153.html

item.title: Iran War Drives India and China to Record Russian Oil Imports
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Middle East war disruptions and Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries drove India and China to absorb over 80% of Russia’s crude exports. But with surging premiums, can this Eurasian energy surge endure past 2026?
[SPLIT] ⚡ Ukrainian strikes disabled nearly 50% of Russian refining capacity, forcing Moscow to export unrefined crude to maintain revenue. [SPLIT] ⚡ Surging ESPO spot premiums of up to $30/bbl over Brent are pricing out China's independent 'teapot' refiners. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/iran-war-drives-india-and-china-to-record-russian-oil-imports-531100.html

item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:

item.title: The Pentagon's Missing Blueprint for Munitions Sovereignty
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:

[SPLIT] ⚡ Decades-long production timelines for complex assets like Patriot interceptors clash with the high-consumption realities of modern asymmetric warfare. [SPLIT] ⚡ Decentralized inventory tracking across individual military services creates massive blind spots and prevents comprehensive department-wide oversight. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/the-pentagon-s-missing-blueprint-for-munitions-sovereignty-292621.html

item.title: When Uniforms Clash: The Jorhat Traffic Incident and Civil-Military Friction
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:

[SPLIT] ⚡ District Transport Officer Dhananjay Saikia clarified that the fine was strictly for a seatbelt violation, debunking social media rumors regarding license invalidity. [SPLIT] ⚡ The incident underscores distinct legal frameworks governing civilian and military driving credentials, where military licenses do not automatically extend to non-tactical private vehicles. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/when-uniforms-clash-the-jorhat-traffic-incident-and-civil-military-friction-210916.html

item.title: Toti Rejects Overseas Warship Building for US-Based Foreign Shipyards
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:

[SPLIT] ⚡ The strategy explicitly rejects the administration's push to build core surface combatants in overseas yards like those in South Korea and Japan. item.title: Appropriators Slash Trump’s $17B Golden Dome Request in Draft Bill

item.description:

item.title: Weaponized SaaS Supply Chains: Inside the Optimizely Malware Exploitation
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:

[SPLIT] ⚡ The attack payload featured advanced iOS exploit kits (Coruna and DarkSword) linked to Russian state-aligned threat actors alongside commercial financial skimming engines. [SPLIT] ⚡ High-value enterprise and media portals—including Zoom, Salesforce, CNN, and the BBC—served as unintended distribution vectors for high-tier mobile zero-day and N-day exploits. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/weaponized-saas-supply-chains-inside-the-optimizely-malware-exploitation-005870.html
